content:
[L] high | message body right edge | customer message text "…nothing happens" is clipped at the card edge with no padding, characters cut off at panel boundary.
[L] high | State row in right details panel | the horizontal chip row (new/investigating/waiting-customer/waiting-engineering/ready-…) overflows past the white card's right edge and is truncated at the panel border ("ready-" cut off).
[L] high | bottom composer strip | the composer spans only under the reading pane while the details card above extends wider than it, creating mismatched right edges and a dead column of background between composer and window edge.
[L] med | right panel vs composer | the details card and composer edges do not align vertically; the composer appears to collide with/run beneath the panel column rather than a shared grid.
[L] med | conversation list bottom | last row "#506 Mobile app crashes on start" is cut off mid-row at the window bottom edge with no fade or scrollbar affordance.
[L] med | list header controls | the search field's text "search conver…" is truncated; the search input, "#" button, and "Apply" button have three different heights/widths jammed together.
[S] high | composer To/Cc/Bcc rows | the "To" row has no input box while Cc and Bcc do; labels and fields are inconsistently inset (To value indented further than Cc/Bcc inputs).
[S] med | list rows | vertical gaps between rows vary (row 1 block vs rows 2–3 vs rows 4–6) — inconsistent padding between conversation items.
[S] med | right panel header | timestamp/metadata "· Support · Priori…" is truncated with ellipsis while status chip and Copilot button float with uneven gaps at top right.
[S] med | views rail vs list | left rail items and list items use different left insets; the rail's active row highlight doesn't align with the list column grid.
[S] low | toolbar row | "Filters", "Reset", and "Sync now" are spaced unevenly with a large dead gap between Reset and Sync now.
[H] med | details panel | every property row (Status/Assignee/Priority/State/Tags/Snooze) uses the same weight; chip groups read as competing button rows, no clear primary field.
[H] med | list rows | subject, sender name, avatar, and status pill all fight at similar weight; "Unassigned" italic style is a one-off not used elsewhere.
[H] low | composer footer | "reply — sent to the customer · Ctrl+Enter sends" mixes hint and shortcut text in one line at tiny low-contrast size.
[C] high | overall three-column composition | the list column and reading column have no visible separators or background differentiation; everything floats on the same white surface, reading as unstructured debug panels.
[C] med | details panel chips | five chip groups packed at top while the message area below is sparse — dense control dump over an empty conversation, unbalanced.
[C] low | date separator | "2026-02-16" divider floats alone between cards with wide empty margins above and below.
C note: views rail bottom two-thirds is empty dead space.
VERDICT: unprofessional — truncated text, misaligned composer, and overflowing control chips make this read as a rough prototype, not shippable product UI.
